questions.text: What is the primary objective of the strategic partnerships announced by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) with HSBC India and J.P. Morgan Payments?

options.text: To launch a dedicated physical currency exchange counter at international airports
To enable real-time foreign exchange (FX) conversion and faster settlement for international UPI payments
To provide short-term credit loans for Indian students studying in France and Singapore
To replace the QR code-based system with a biometric card-based system for global payments
To establish a blockchain-based decentralized network for all international payment transactions initiated via UPI

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is To enable real-time foreign exchange (FX) conversion and faster settlement for international UPI payments

In News

  • National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) has partnered with HSBC India and J.P. Morgan Payments to enhance the international Unified Payments Interface (UPI) ecosystem.

Key Points

  • The primary goal of the collaborations is to introduce real-time foreign exchange (FX) conversion and settlement for cross-border UPI transactions.
  • The partnership with HSBC India involves direct API integration to provide real-time exchange rates, allowing travelers to see the exact amount in Indian Rupees (INR) before payment.
  • The collaboration with J.P. Morgan Payments combines NPCI's infrastructure with the bank's API-based integration to support end-to-end FX conversion across multiple currencies.
  • These moves are designed to offer transparent pricing, reduce friction, and provide faster settlement for Indians making payments overseas.
  • Option 1 is incorrect as the focus is on digital infrastructure, not physical counters. Option 3 and 4 are incorrect as the news does not mention credit loans or biometric card systems.

Additional Information

  • UPI is currently available in nine countries: Singapore, the United Arab Emirates, Nepal, Bhutan, Mauritius, France, Sri Lanka, Qatar, and Cambodia.
  • NPCI is the umbrella organization for retail payments in India, established by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the Indian Banks' Association (IBA).
  • It operates as a not-for-profit company providing critical payment and settlement infrastructure.

Important Points

  • This partnership supports the global acceptance of India’s digital public infrastructure.
  • The system enables 24x7 cross-border payments and allows international merchants to receive payments in their local currencies.

questions.text: According to the merger scheme approved by the Boards of Directors of PFC and REC, what is the specific share exchange ratio for the shareholders of REC?

options.text: 100 equity shares of PFC for every 88 equity shares of REC
88 equity shares of PFC for every 100 equity shares of REC
75 equity shares of PFC for every 100 equity shares of REC
50 equity shares of PFC for every 50 equity shares of REC
60 equity shares of PFC for every 100 equity shares of REC

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 88 equity shares of PFC for every 100 equity shares of REC

In News

  • The Board of Directors of Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC) and REC Limited (REC) have approved a scheme of merger on 30 June 2026.

Key Points

  • Share Exchange Ratio: According to the valuation reports, the ratio for the merger of REC into PFC shall be 88 equity shares of PFC of INR 10/- each fully paid up for every 100 equity shares of REC of INR 10/- each fully paid up.
  • Transferor and Transferee: In this scheme, REC is the Transferor Company and PFC is the Transferee Company.
  • Aggregate Loan Book: The merger will create a massive financing entity with an aggregate loan book exceeding INR 11 lakh crore.
  • Legal Framework: The merger is being conducted under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

Additional Information

  • Advisors: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP is the Transaction and Tax Advisor, while Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas serves as the Legal Advisor to both entities.
  • Valuation: RBSA Valuation Advisors LLP was appointed by PFC and Ernst & Young Merchant Banking Services LLP was appointed by REC for joint valuation reports.
  • Fairness Opinions: SBI Capital Markets (for PFC) and Nuvama Wealth Management (for REC) provided fairness opinions on the valuation.

Important Points

  • The merger is conditional upon the merged entity continuing to qualify as a Government Company.
  • The Government of India must continue to retain majority voting rights and control in the merged entity, either directly or indirectly.

questions.text: What is the total acquisition cost for Kotak Mahindra Bank to acquire Deutsche Bank’s India retail, private banking, and wealth management business?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Rs 282 crore

In News

  • Kotak Mahindra Bank has agreed to acquire Deutsche Bank’s retail banking, affluent private banking, and wealth management business in India for a total consideration of Rs 282 crore.

Key Points

  • Acquisition Cost: The transaction is valued at Rs 282 crore, which covers the purchase of the retail and wealth management franchise of the German lender in India.
  • Business Scale: The acquired business includes loans worth approximately Rs 29,000 crore, deposits of Rs 16,000 crore, and assets under management (AUM) of Rs 10,500 crore.
  • Customer and Employee Base: The deal covers about 1.5 lakh customers and around 1,000 employees who are expected to transition to Kotak Mahindra Bank.
  • Timeline: The acquisition is expected to be completed by September 2027, pending regulatory approvals from the Competition Commission of India (CCI).

Additional Information

  • Kotak Mahindra Bank Status: As of March 31, 2026, the bank had 5,581 branches and total assets worth Rs 10,03,353 crore.
  • Deutsche Bank Strategy: The sale is part of its Global Hausbank strategy, focusing on simplification and areas of scale like corporate and investment banking.
  • Market Presence: Despite the sale, Deutsche Bank remains the largest European bank in India and maintains operations in locations like GIFT City.

Important Points

  • Strategic Alignment: The deal aligns with Kotak’s focus on affluent and SME customer segments to add scale and depth.
  • Financial Impact: The transaction is expected to be return-on-equity accretive for Kotak Mahindra Bank and common equity tier-1 accretive for Deutsche Bank upon closing.

questions.text: What is the total financial outlay for the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme (CMPS) framework announced in the Union Budget 2026 for domestic container manufacturing?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is ₹10,000 crore

In News

  • Union Minister of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Sarbananda Sonowal, unveiled the first Made-in-India export-import (EXIM) shipping container for A.P. Moller–Maersk in Dadri, Uttar Pradesh.

Key Points

  • The Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme (CMPS) framework was announced in the Union Budget 2026 with a total financial outlay of ₹10,000 crore.
  • The scheme is designed to promote domestic container manufacturing and reduce India's dependence on imported containers, thereby strengthening supply chain resilience.
  • The policy aims to achieve a tenfold jump in annual container manufacturing capacity, targeting up to 7.9 lakh TEUs (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units).
  • It includes provisions for Capex support for greenfield and brownfield facilities, Opex support to improve competitiveness, and Research & Development (R&D) support.
  • The other options (₹5,000 crore, ₹15,000 crore, and ₹20,000 crore) are incorrect as they do not match the figure specified in the Union Budget 2026 for the CMPS framework.

Additional Information

  • Following the rollout, Maersk placed an order for 1,000 additional India-manufactured containers with the DCM Shriram Group.
  • The containers are produced in accordance with ISO specifications and the International Convention for Safe Containers (CSC) standards.
  • This initiative is a part of the Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047 and the Atmanirbhar Bharat vision of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

Important Points

  • The government has introduced key legislations like the Merchant Shipping Act, 2025, the Coastal Shipping Act, 2025, and the Indian Ports Act, 2025 to modernize the sector.
  • A ₹70,000 crore Shipbuilding Financial Assistance Package has been established to support maritime manufacturing.
  • Digital transformations such as One Nation One Port Process (ONOP) and the Maritime Single Window have been launched to enhance the ease of doing business.

questions.text: Which Ahmedabad-based scholar has been selected for the Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar 2025 for his contribution to the Haveli Sangeet tradition?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Acharya Ranchhodlal Goswami

In News

  • Ahmedabad-based Haveli Sangeet scholar Acharya Ranchhodlal Goswami has been selected for the Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar 2025.

Key Points

  • Award Body: The award was announced by the Sangeet Natak Akademi under the Union Ministry of Culture for the 2024-25 awards cycle.
  • Recipient: Acharya Ranchhodlal Goswami is the 16th-generation Acharya of the Goswami Haveli in the Kalupur area of Ahmedabad.
  • Contribution: He is recognized for preserving and promoting Haveli Sangeet, a devotional musical tradition rooted in the Pushtimarg sect.
  • Personal Achievement: At the age of 32, Goswami has composed more than 22,000 devotional verses and authored eight books.
  • Other Options: Mahaprabhu Vallabhacharya (founder of Pushtimarg), Surdas (Ashtachhap poet), and Vitthalnath are historical figures associated with the origins and development of the tradition, not contemporary award winners.

Additional Information

  • Haveli Sangeet: A devotional genre believed to have evolved alongside Pushtimarg established by Mahaprabhu Vallabhacharya around 550 years ago.
  • Musical Heritage: It incorporates ancient forms like Prabandha, Dhrupad, and Dhamar, which later influenced Khayal singing.
  • Linguistic Diversity: Goswami's compositions span several languages including Vrajbhasha, Gujarati, Sanskrit, Charani, Mewari, and Marwari.

Important Points

  • This marks perhaps the first time since Independence that Haveli Sangeet has received recognition at such a high national level.
  • The tradition is actively practiced in Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Punjab.

questions.text: Who has been appointed as the 31st Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) of India?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is General Dhiraj Seth

In News

  • General Dhiraj Seth has officially taken over as the 31st Chief of the Army Staff (COAS).

Key Points

  • General Dhiraj Seth assumed the appointment of Chief of the Army Staff on 30 June 2026.
  • He succeeds General Upendra Dwivedi, who superannuated from service on the same date.
  • By taking this charge, he becomes the 31st officer to lead the Indian Army as its Chief.
  • The transition marks a significant leadership change in the Ministry of Defence's military hierarchy.

Additional Information

  • General Upendra Dwivedi retired after more than four decades of distinguished service to the nation.
  • The Chief of the Army Staff is the operational head and the highest-ranking officer of the Indian Army.

Important Points

  • The appointment was effective from 30 June 2026.
  • He holds prestigious decorations including the PVSM (Param Vishisht Seva Medal), UYSM (Uttam Yudh Seva Medal), and AVSM (Ati Vishisht Seva Medal).

questions.text: Which high-resolution radio array was utilized in the 2026 study to identify a hidden population of weakly active black holes in nearly one-quarter of the galaxies studied?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is e-MERLIN radio array

In News

  • In July 2026, the Ministry of Science & Technology announced that a high-resolution radio study revealed widespread faint black hole activity in nearby galaxies, many of which were previously difficult to detect.

Key Points

  • The study utilized the e-MERLIN radio array, which functions as an interferometer with 7 radio telescopes across the UK.
  • The researchers observed 280 nearby galaxies selected from the Palomar sample to probe central regions on parsec scales.
  • The team detected compact radio emission from the centres of nearly one-quarter of the galaxies, indicating the presence of weakly accreting supermassive black holes.
  • The use of e-MERLIN was crucial because earlier studies lacked the sensitivity and angular resolution required to separate weak nuclear emission from surrounding stellar activity.
  • The other options like ALMA, SKA, and VLA are world-class radio observatories but were not the specific instruments used for this 2026 high-resolution survey mentioned in the text.

Additional Information

  • The international team included Dr. Aru Beri from the Indian Institute of Astrophysics (IIA), an autonomous institution under the Department of Science and Technology (DST).
  • To verify the results, radio observations were complemented with X-ray data from NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory.
  • The study, authored by D. R. A. Williams-Baldwin and collaborators, was published in the Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society.

Important Points

  • The results suggest that faint, low-level black hole activity may be the dominant mode of black hole growth in the present-day Universe.
  • Uncovering these "hidden monsters" is vital as they can influence star formation rates and the long-term evolution of galaxies through jets and outflows.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the outcomes of the Prime Minister’s visit to Indonesia in July 2026:

1. A Strategic Joint Venture was signed between the Steel Authority of India (SAIL) and Pt. Krakatau Steel for a manufacturing facility in Indonesia.
2. India committed to providing 200 tonnes of high-quality DWR 162 wheat seeds to Indonesia as part of agricultural cooperation.
3. The Indonesia Open Network (ION) will be launched, based on the Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC) architecture of India.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 1 and 3 only

In News

  • The Prime Minister’s visit to Indonesia in July 2026 resulted in several MoUs, agreements, and announcements across sectors like defense, agriculture, and technology.

Key Points

  • Statement 1 is correct: A Strategic Joint Venture was signed between the Steel Authority of India (SAIL) and Pt. Krakatau Steel specifically for the establishment of a Stainless-Steel Slab manufacturing facility in Indonesia.
  • Statement 2 is incorrect: While India did announce the supply of wheat seeds, the quantity mentioned is 100 tonnes of high-quality DWR 162 wheat seeds, not 200 tonnes.
  • Statement 3 is correct: One of the major technological announcements was the launch of the Indonesia Open Network (ION), which is based on the Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC) architecture developed in India.

Additional Information

  • An agreement was also reached regarding the BrahMos Missile System and an Air-to-Air Missile Cooperation Agreement.
  • The Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Bangalore is set to establish a branch campus at the Singhasari SEZ in Indonesia.
  • There is an MoU between the Election Commission of India (ECI) and the General Elections Commission (KPU) of Indonesia for electoral cooperation.

Important Points

  • India will provide assistance for the conservation and restoration of the Prambanan Temple Complex in Yogyakarta.
  • A Tagore-Dewantara Year of Cultural and Educational Diplomacy was announced to commemorate cultural ties.
  • MoU on development of Rare Earth Magnets was signed between NFTDC, Midwest Ltds., and PT PERMINAS.

questions.text: Where is the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM Bangalore) set to establish its first overseas campus, as announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi?

options.text: Abu Dhabi Global Market, Abu Dhabi

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Singhasari Special Economic Zone, Malang

In News

  • Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto announced the establishment of IIM Bangalore's first overseas campus in Indonesia.

Key Points

  • The first international campus of IIM Bangalore will be located in the Singhasari Special Economic Zone (SEZ) in Malang, Indonesia.
  • The campus is being established through a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between IIM Bangalore and PT Intelegensia Grahatama (PT IGT), the managing entity of the SEZ.
  • This initiative is aimed at benefiting students across the ASEAN region and strengthening the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between India and Indonesia.
  • The project will be implemented in two phases, starting with executive education programmes followed by full-fledged degree programmes after two years.
  • The curriculum will focus on five emerging areas: global supply chains, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, climate and sustainability, and healthcare management.

Additional Information

  • The initiative aligns with India’s National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, which promotes the internationalisation of higher education.
  • Other premier Indian institutions that have established overseas campuses include IIM Ahmedabad in Dubai, IIT Delhi in Abu Dhabi, and IIT Madras in Zanzibar.
  • The campus will serve as a regional hub for management education in Southeast Asia and provide exposure to India's innovation ecosystem through immersion programmes.

Important Points

  • This marks the first-ever international campus for IIM Bangalore.
  • The campus will primarily cater to Indonesian students and participants from neighbouring ASEAN countries.
  • Indonesia recently conferred its highest civilian award, the 'Bintang Adipurna', upon PM Narendra Modi.

questions.text: What is the specific age range covered under the Samagra Shishu Bal Swasthya Karyakram (SSBSK) for providing a seamless continuum of home and community-based care?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Birth to 36 months

In News

  • Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare, Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda, launched the Samagra Shishu Bal Swasthya Karyakram (SSBSK) during the 16th CCHFW Meeting on June 29, 2026.

Key Points

  • The SSBSK is a unified national programme designed to provide a seamless continuum of home and community-based care for every child from birth to 36 months of age.
  • The programme integrates the existing Home-Based Newborn Care (HBNC) and Home-Based Care for Young Child (HBYC) programmes into a single comprehensive framework.
  • It focuses on the critical importance of the first 28 days for survival and the first three years for optimal brain development.
  • The initiative embodies the vision of "पहले तीन साल सम्पूर्ण देखभाल" (Comprehensive Care During the First Three Years). Therefore, the correct age range is birth to 36 months.

Additional Information

  • Risk-stratified approach: 'At-risk' newborns (due to low birth weight, prematurity, etc.) will receive up to nine home visits during the first 42 days of life.
  • At-risk children: These children will receive up to eight home visits up to the age of 36 months.
  • Coordinated Care: The programme involves coordinated visits by ASHAs, ANMs, Community Health Officers (CHOs), and Anganwadi Workers (AWWs).
  • Digital Integration: The system will be integrated with national platforms like the JANANI Portal, U-WIN Portal, RBSK 2.0 Portal, and POSHAN Tracker using ABHA and Baal-ABHA IDs.

Important Points

  • SSBSK introduces Well-Baby Sessions at every Village Health, Sanitation and Nutrition Day (VHSND) and a monthly Shishu Shivir at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs.
  • It incorporates post-partum maternal mental health screening as part of community-based care.
  • The guidelines specifically address risks like excessive screen exposure and promote age-appropriate play and physical activity for brain development.

questions.text: Under the new e-OCI Card system launched by the Union Home Minister, which requirement for OCI cardholders has been eliminated after they receive a new passport post the age of 20 years?

options.text: Mandatory physical presence for immigration clearance
Fresh application for a unique registration number
Linking Aadhaar details with the OCI card

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Re-issuing the OCI booklet

In News

  • Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah launched the FCRA 2.0 Portal and e-OCI Card in New Delhi on 30 June 2026.

Key Points

  • Elimination of OCI Booklet: Under the new arrangement, the requirement to re-issue the OCI booklet upon receiving a new passport after the age of 20 years has been eliminated. Hence, Option 2 is correct.
  • Online Updates: While the booklet re-issuance is gone, cardholders will still need to update their passport-related details online whenever a new passport is issued. Thus, Option 1 is incorrect as it is a requirement, not something eliminated.
  • Registration Number: The system ensures the cardholder’s registration number will become unique, but it does not eliminate the need for having a registration number. Thus, Option 4 is incorrect.
  • Immigration Benefits: The e-OCI card facilitates smoother travel and faster immigration clearance, but physical presence for travel is still a standard procedure, and the card's digital nature specifically targets document loss/damage issues. Option 3 is incorrect as it is not the primary process eliminated.

Additional Information

  • The e-OCI Card initiative is expected to benefit more than 50 lakh OCI cardholders worldwide.
  • The FCRA 2.0 Portal is hosted on 'MeghRaj' (the National Government Cloud) to ensure high security and reduce the possibility of data theft.
  • Key features of the new portal include OCR-based document analysis, e-Sign-based authentication, and integration with the NGO Darpan bank account system.

Important Points

  • The initiatives were launched under the principle of 'Minimum Government, Maximum Governance' to enhance transparency and security.
  • Currently, there are approximately 14,500 active FCRA organisations in India that will benefit from the digital compliance system.
  • The government plans to introduce an AI-powered chatbot and a dedicated online dashboard for banks in the coming months.

questions.text: Which organization presented the 2026 Leadership Award to Sunil Bharti Mittal for his contributions to transforming India's telecommunications landscape?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is US-India Strategic Partnership Forum (USISPF)

In News

  • The US-India Strategic Partnership Forum (USISPF) announced the recipients of its 2026 Leadership Award, recognizing key business figures for their roles in strengthening international ties.

Key Points

  • The US-India Strategic Partnership Forum (USISPF) is the organization that presented the 2026 Leadership Award.
  • Sunil Bharti Mittal, the founder and chairman of Bharti Enterprises, was a primary recipient of this award.
  • The recognition was specifically for his role in transforming India's telecommunications landscape and his contributions to advancing economic ties between India and North America.
  • The other options mentioned are not the award-giving body: Bharti Enterprises is the company founded by Mittal, while Fairfax Financial Holdings and RTX Corporation are organizations led by other award recipients (V Prem Watsa and Christopher T Calio, respectively).

Additional Information

  • Apart from Sunil Bharti Mittal, V Prem Watsa, the chairman and CEO of Fairfax Financial Holdings, was also honored with the Leadership Award.
  • Christopher T Calio, the chairman and CEO of RTX Corporation, received the award alongside Mittal and Watsa for his contributions to the India-US strategic and economic partnership.

Important Points

  • The award ceremony highlights the ongoing efforts to bolster strategic and economic cooperation between India and the United States.
  • The leaders were recognized for their global business leadership and their impact on fostering bilateral investment and trade.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the Happy City Index 2026:

1. London has been ranked as the world's happiest city in the index.
2. Jaipur is the only Indian city to secure a place in the global top 10 rankings.
3. The index ranked Paris at the second position globally, followed by New York City.
4. Governance, Economy, and Mobility are among the indicators used to evaluate the cities.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Only 1, 2, and 4

In News

  • The Happy City Index 2026 was recently released, highlighting the world's happiest cities based on various quality-of-life indicators.

Key Points

  • Statement 1 is correct: London, United Kingdom, has topped the Happy City Index 2026, ranking first globally.
  • Statement 2 is correct: Jaipur secured the 6th position globally and is the only Indian city to feature in the top 10 list.
  • Statement 3 is incorrect: According to the index, New York City is ranked 2nd and Paris is ranked 3rd. The statement incorrectly swaps their positions.
  • Statement 4 is correct: The index evaluates cities using several indicators including Governance, Citizens and community engagement, Economy, Environment, Health, and Mobility.

Additional Information

  • Jaipur's high ranking is attributed to its vibrant architecture, cultural heritage, tourism, and modern urban development.
  • The top 5 cities in the index are London (1st), New York City (2nd), Paris (3rd), Tokyo (4th), and Madrid (5th).

Important Points

  • London leads in multiple indicators such as governance, economy, and quality of life.
  • The index includes cities that demonstrate high quality of life and sustainable urban development.

questions.text: Under which mission was the 'Drug Registry' conceptualized to serve as a unified and standardized digital platform for medicine-related information in India?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission

In News

  • Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare, Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda, launched the Drug Registry on June 29, 2026, to standardize medicine-related information across India's healthcare ecosystem.

Key Points

  • The Drug Registry was conceptualized under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) to act as a single source of truth for medicines.
  • It addresses challenges like inconsistencies, duplication, and data entry errors caused by the same drug being represented by different names across various healthcare systems.
  • The registry enables consistent identification, storage, and exchange of drug data, which is vital for clinical decision-making and e-prescriptions.
  • It has been developed in collaboration with the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) and the National Resource Centre for EHR Standards (NRCeS), Pune.

Additional Information

  • The registry utilizes international standards like SNOMED CT to ensure interoperability and semantic consistency.
  • As of the launch, the database includes over 123,000 branded drugs, 10,000 generic drugs, and 29,000 substances.
  • The ABDM ecosystem now comprises four core registries: ABHA Registry (individuals), Healthcare Professional Registry (HPR), Health Facility Registry (HFR), and the newly added Drug Registry.

Important Points

  • The platform provides open APIs for integration with Hospital Management Information Systems (HMIS) and other digital health solutions.
  • It allows users to search for drugs based on generic name, brand name, substance, or manufacturer, fostering transparency and trust in the healthcare sector.

questions.text: What is the primary focus of 'Operation Chakra-VI' recently conducted by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)?

options.text: Investigating money laundering in real estate projects
Dismantling a nationwide digital arrest fraud network
Crackdown on illegal migration across international borders
Regulation of cryptocurrency exchanges operating in India
Targeting counterfeit currency distribution networks across the country

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Dismantling a nationwide digital arrest fraud network

In News

  • The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) conducted nationwide raids at more than 80 locations across 16 states as part of Operation Chakra-VI.

Key Points

  • Operation Chakra-VI was launched to target and dismantle an operational network involved in over 200 cases of digital arrest scams that have plagued the country for years.
  • The CBI constituted 60 special teams to carry out searches in states including Punjab, Gujarat, Delhi, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal, and Karnataka, among others.
  • Two individuals, one from Kolkata and one from Chennai, were arrested for incorporating shell companies and operating mule bank accounts used to launder approximately ₹2 crore in crime proceeds.
  • The fraudsters utilized a fraudulent website with a URL deceptively similar to the official website of the Supreme Court of India to deceive victims.
  • Investigators found that the network also defrauded foreign nationals, and the CBI is contacting law enforcement agencies in those jurisdictions.

Additional Information

  • A report by TransUnion highlighted that Indian consumers lost 36% more than the global average to digital fraud in 2025.
  • While the global median loss stood at $1,671, the median loss for Indian consumers was $2,265.
  • The CBI used advanced forensic tools and technical expertise to identify the criminal infrastructure, including forged documents and fake court orders.

Important Points

  • The CBI's action followed an FIR lodged after a complaint by the Registry of the Supreme Court regarding a fake website.
  • The 16 states involved in the raids include: Punjab, Gujarat, Delhi, Maharashtra, Haryana, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Assam, West Bengal, Manipur, Karnataka, and Odisha.
